ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels to 65% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity regions along the leading edges of both lobes; extensive white mottling and linear streaks concentrated on the right lobe; scattered punctate white spots within the central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary featuring high-frequency serrations; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the distal portions of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Biphasic curve showing distal concavity near the fluke tips transitioning into a broad convexity approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white pixel patterns (rosette-like) identified on the central dark region and the distal right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe, with additional horizontal abrasions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the right lobe; several localized circular scars concentrated near the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive crescent-shaped high-intensity white mark located on the left lateral side of the peduncle.
